title: Privacy-preserving challenge anti-collusion and integrity operations are absent

original_titles.title: Integrity console and signal catalogue entirely missing (IN-01..IN-06, SIG-01..SIG-05)
integrity_officer role and integrity console absent; audit-log row cannot be satisfied
Integrity subsystem missing: signals, telemetry endpoint, console, integrity_officer role
Integrity module and console entirely absent

problem: There is no distinct integrity_officer role, integrity console, signal catalogue or telemetry ingestion/analyser workflow. The current roles fold integrity activity into reviewer/organizer. Watermarking and file-order shuffling are also not implemented.
impact: The event lacks structured evidence for suspected collusion, answer leakage or coordinated probing, and no two-officer disqualification process exists.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Define a minimal signal catalogue and data minimization policy with an explicit retention period. Do not collect process/screen telemetry unless the owner/legal review approves it and participants are clearly informed.
Add a separate integrity_officer role with scoped read/write permissions and immutable case records; prevent that role from editing GT or scoring.
Implement batched telemetry ingestion with rate limits and a 202 response, plus background analysis that creates cases rather than automatically disqualifying users.
Build a case console for dismiss, warn, investigate, propose penalty and propose disqualification. Require two distinct officers for disqualification/reinstatement.
Add audit evidence links and tests that reviewers cannot resolve integrity cases and integrity officers cannot edit answer keys.

acceptance_criteria: A separate role and scope matrix exists.
All signals have purpose, consent/disclosure and retention policy.
Disqualification requires two officers and is appealable under the published rules.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: If integrity telemetry is not used for this event, record a formal scope waiver and remove misleading readiness claims.
